question.html:
An object attached to a spring oscillates with simple harmonic motion in a horizontal plane. The graph shows how the kinetic energy of the object varies with the displacement x.

a State the amplitude of the motion. [1]

b Draw, on the axes above, the variation with x of the potential energy stored in the spring. [1]

c Explain how many times during one oscillation the kinetic energy of the object and the potential energy stored in the spring are equal. [2]

d The mass of the object is 0.15 kg.

d.i Show that the period of the oscillations is about 0.7 s. [3]

d.ii Calculate the maximum force exerted on the object by the spring. [2]
